Title: NAME THE TEAM
Detail_lesson: Before anything else, decide what to call ourselves.
CustomInstruction: Give one name and the reason in five words or fewer. Names that describe what we do beat names that sound impressive.

Title: WHO IS THE CUSTOMER
Detail_lesson: Not the market. One describable person or role we are building for.
CustomInstruction: Describe a single person: their job, what their day looks like, and one thing they are measured on. Say 'everyone' and the room will vote you down.

Title: WHAT HURTS TODAY
Detail_lesson: The problem as the customer would state it, in their words rather than ours.
CustomInstruction: Write it as a complaint that customer would actually say out loud. If it contains the word 'solution' or 'platform', rewrite it.

Title: HOW WE HELP
Detail_lesson: The smallest thing we could do that removes the pain named in step three.
CustomInstruction: Describe one concrete action, and how the customer would notice the difference. If your answer would take more than a quarter to deliver, cut it down.
